info.title: LingBloomTalk API
info.description: REST API for the LingBloomTalk web and mobile apps. All responses use the `{ data, meta? }` envelope; errors use `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`.

get.summary: Everything in one payload for offline caching
Language catalog, featured first then by name
Phrases of one situation in one language (LearnPhrase[] + wordPieces)
Career language detail incl. lessons and phrases

post.summary: Create an account
Log in with email + password
Rotate the refresh token (web: cookie, mobile: body)
Revoke the current session
Sign out of all devices
Confirm an email address
Send the verification email again
Request a password reset email (always 202)
Set a new password with a reset token
Change password (signs out every other device)

delete.summary: Delete the account (soft delete now, purge after 7 days)

get.summary: Full JSON export of every learner collection

put.summary: Save this device (voices are per device)

post.summary: Wipe learner data (never seeds demo data)

get.summary: Full learner snapshot in the exact client shapes (ProgressState + PhrasebookState)
Delta since a stateVersion (or { full: true, … } when too old)
Dashboard numbers (also what Pip personalises with)
Daily XP for charts (zero-filled, max 400 days)
Review cards due today or earlier, with phrase content

post.summary: Mark a phrase as heard (+2 XP the first time)
Record a pronunciation attempt (+5 XP when score ≥ 0.7)
Record a finished test (stars, review queue, XP)
Add phrases to the review queue (box 0, due today)
Answer a review card (Leitner move, +5 XP on knewIt)
Practice quiz result (+10 XP per correct)
Record a language visit (recent list)
Push an outbox of offline ops, get the delta back
post.description: Op types: phrase.heard, phrase.speak, phrase.note, phrase.favorite, word.favorite, test.recorded, review.add, review.answer, lesson.complete, lesson.bookmark, practice.answered, language.visit, prefs.update. Max 500 ops, 1 MB.

post.summary: One-time upload of a guest's local state on first sign-in
post.description: Lenient by design: unknown fields/keys are dropped and reported in `meta.dropped` instead of failing. Untouched demo seed data is ignored.

post.summary: Translate items, cache-first (501 until enabled)
Ask Pip (phase 2, 501 until enabled)
Reseed content from source-data (dry run by default, returns the diff)

patch.summary: Disable / enable a user or change their role

get.summary: DAU, ops per day, sync errors
